name: Luneau
description: The vampire city of Ixalan, whose palace, ballroom, menagerie and cultural district are wrecked by Vivien and her summoned beasts.

relations.quote: The sovereign rulers of Luneau tipped their heads

pages_say.description: The marble vampire island kingdom on Ixalan with the Perfumed Court, Royal Menagerie and Hall of Treasures.
The opulent city ruled by King Lucard, with a criminal underbelly of corridors beneath it, where the baron holds Vivien.
